outcome: Biometric measurements of the levator ani
finding: Vaginal delivery, especially with larger fetal head circumference and weight leading to prolonged labor, is associated with a higher risk of levator ani muscle defect and morphological changes in the levator hiatus compared to cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with larger hiatal dimensions, higher rates of levator defect and loss of tenting compared to cesarean delivery.
